===========================================
SAFESTORE - Sistema de Gestion de Minimarket
===========================================

VERSION: 2.0
DESARROLLADO POR: The Softwarriors

REQUISITOS
-----------
- Windows 7/8/10/11, Linux o MacOS
- Java Runtime Environment (JRE) 8 o superior
- Conexion a Internet

INSTALACION (Windows)
---------------------
Ejecute install.bat como Administrador

EJECUCION
---------
- Windows: Ejecute run.bat
- Linux/Mac: Ejecute ./run.sh

DESINSTALACION (Windows)
------------------------
Ejecute uninstall.bat
